campaign.title: Whole-discrepancy twelfth moment: weighted source and exact resonances

resource_policy.budget: Three bounded analytical/source reports and one repair/review cycle; no numerical experiments.

frozen_target.question: Can the complete whole-discrepancy twelfth moment be bounded by Y^(4+eta+epsilon) with eta<13theta_LY-4, using a fixed-window weighted square-root expansion; if not, what exact signed offdiagonal estimate and power gap remain?
frozen_target.reference_formula: T=sqrt(Y), delta=T^(-1/2), a_n(T)=r_2(n)n^(-3/4)Psi(sqrt(n/T)), H_T(R)=sum a_n(T)cos(2pi R sqrt(n)-3pi/4). Target int w(R/T)|H_T(R)|^12 dR << T^(1+2eta+epsilon). Expand all 2^12 signs with phase e(-3 sum signs/8) and T w-hat(-T sum signs sqrt(n)); retain nonzero differences signed.
quantities: rho is fixed smooth radial nonnegative unit-mass compact disk support; w is fixed nonnegative smooth compactly supported away from zero and equals one on [1/sqrt(2),sqrt(3)].
The exact-resonance class includes nonpairing relations within one squarefree radical; no probabilistic independence on the finite radius interval is assumed.
Known low moments are normalization evidence, not a twelfth-moment theorem.
Moment-to-pointwise theta=(1+p/4+eta)/(p+1); at p=12 it is (4+eta)/13. This route does not discharge M1 or M2 obligations.

completion_criteria: Exact whole-source smoothing/Bessel/tail and twelfth-moment identities.
Independent all-configuration exact-resonance proof or counterexample.
Known second-moment normalization and audited current high-moment benchmark.
Complete target inequality or explicit signed offdiagonal estimate with quantitative remaining gap.
Independent seams, graph validation and a reversible State Patch before any promotion.

tasks.target: Derive the complete whole-discrepancy Poisson-Bessel expansion with delta=T^(-1/2) fixed across R~T, fixed a_n(T), exact all-sign twelfth-moment Fourier kernel, all errors/tails and real-radius endpoints. Reproduce the known second-moment upper exponent as normalization. Attack the complete twelfth-moment target, retaining signed displaced offdiagonal phase; if open, state its exact inequality and net eta deficit. You may audit primary standard Bessel/Poisson sources as needed and log exact hypotheses. Read only assigned context plus exact standard antecedents you identify. Write only your report.
required_output: Seven-section report with exact statements, proof/source audit, first open step, controls and state recommendation.
Write only assigned report; no shared-state edits or next round.

tasks.target: Independently prove/refute the absolute weighted exact-resonance claim in the statement packet, including squarefree radical independence, all nonpairing configurations, uniformity and infinite limits. No finite-window near-resonance theorem may be inferred. Write only your seven-section report and stop.

tasks.target: Search current primary literature for actual circle discrepancy moment estimates relevant to p=12. Audit normalization radius versus squared radius, signed versus absolute moments, allowed orders, weights, source versions/withdrawals, and constants/ranges. Inspect Zhai arXiv:0805.1523 and other genuinely relevant primary papers; a divisor theorem is not a circle theorem without an exact source transfer. Do not silently extrapolate a fourth moment or import a new pointwise exponent. Record exact sources and the first failed hypothesis. Write only your report (including source cards within it); no shared source/graph edits.
